title: Hold a liquor licence to sell alcohol
what: Hold a liquor licence from Liquor Control Victoria before supplying alcohol; a restaurant and cafe licence requires meals to be the main activity.

sources.title: Self-paced guide: Restaurant and cafe licence
sources.quote: A restaurant and cafe licence requires that the main activity of the restaurant or cafe is the preparation and serving of meals consumed on premises.

reach.condition: if it sells or supplies alcohol
